# Round 5: offence and defence rankings (generated by research/round5_offdef.py)

Rank correlation between a rating published before week w (weeks 4-14) and the team's remaining-season points scored (offence) or allowed (defence). Higher = better. Every rating is opponent-adjusted the same way as the model's EPA rating. E = EPA/play, E_to = EPA with turnovers at half weight, E_nt = EPA without turnover plays, P = points, S = success rate; "+" = equal-weight blend of z-scores. Keep rule: better than the current rating (E) on both development (2012-19) and holdout (2020-25).
